prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien civilization world, grey-purple ruins, ochre sand, stone cairns. Sky state strictly follow scene. Never use modern laboratory. 
SCENE: 기록자가 돌을 들어 올린다. 탑 위에 올려놓는다 — 탑이 무서울 정도로 높다. 192개의 돌.
Visible named cast: 기록자. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
